assessmentQuestionVersion.name: RecWater_RiskAssessment_Q3
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Non-Compliant: No Pool Safety Plan exists, or significant deficiencies are present such that the facility cannot demonstrate compliance with Pool Safety Plan requirements. Partially Complaint: Pool Safety Plan exists, but deficiencies are identified with its content, implementation, review, employee training, or adherence to procedures. Complaint: Pool Safety Plan is current, contains the required information, employees have been trained, and the facility demonstrates implementation of the plan.
